name: 《篆刻（三）》特种邮票 - 深圳首日实寄NFT #001
name_en: Chinese Seal Engraving III - Shenzhen First Day Cover NFT #001
description: 此NFT是2026年4月20日于深圳南油邮局发生的《篆刻（三）》特种邮票首日实寄事件的确权证明。它通过照片、视频、GPS轨迹及区块链时间戳，构建了完整的时空证据链，证明该物理事件真实发生。本NFT仅记录物理邮寄事件与现场证据，不主张邮票图案本身的任何知识产权；中国邮政集团有限公司拥有《篆刻（三）》特种邮票的全部著作权、商标权及相关知识产权。部分涉及版权的原始素材未公开存储，其完整性可通过链上哈希验证。
description_en: This NFT certifies the first-day mailing event of the "Chinese Seal Engraving III" special stamps at Shenzhen Nanyou Post Office on April 20, 2026. A complete spatiotemporal evidence chain is built with photos, videos, GPS tracks, and blockchain timestamps to prove the event occurred. This NFT only records the physical mailing event and on-site evidence; it does not claim any intellectual property rights in the stamp designs themselves. China Post Group Corporation owns all copyrights, trademarks, and related intellectual property rights of the "Chinese Seal Engraving III" special stamps. Some copyrighted original materials are not publicly stored; their integrity can be verified via on-chain hash values.

copyright_statement.cn: 本NFT为「事件存证类NFT」，仅用于记录真实发生的邮票首日实寄物理事件，不包含邮票图案的任何知识产权授权，亦不用于商业复制、发行或传播邮票本体。中国邮政集团有限公司拥有《篆刻（三）》特种邮票的全部著作权及相关知识产权。
copyright_statement.en: This NFT is an "event proof NFT" only for recording the real physical event of stamp first-day mailing. It does not include any intellectual property license for stamp designs, nor is it used for commercial reproduction, distribution, or communication of stamps themselves. China Post Group Corporation owns all copyrights and related intellectual property rights of the "Chinese Seal Engraving III" special stamps.
